arabic text:
(YABNA JAFFAR, ABUR-RAZA) (ABUR-RAZA)
(YA MUSA-E-KAZIM)
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
O son of Ja‘far, father of
Raza—O Musa al-Kazim. You are the
seventh remover of difficulties, the
light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TERE BABA IMAM-E-SADIQ HAI
JISKE DAM SE HAI JAFFERI SARE
DEEN-O-MAZHAB, SABAK IBADAT HAI
HAM KO SAYE USI KE DAR SE MILE
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Your father is Imam Sadiq; through him
we are all Ja‘fari. Faith, religion and
worship are his teachings, and we
found shelter at his door. You
are the seventh remover of difficulties,
the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
HAI QARAMAT-E-MURTAZA TUJHME
SAA’ILO(N) KE BHI YE ATA TUJHME
RAD JO HOTI NAHI KISI SURAT
SAANS LETI HAI WO DUA TUJHME
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
The miracle of Murtaza is within you.
You grant even to those who ask,
and the prayer that can never
be rejected lives within you. You
are the seventh remover of difficulties,
the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TUM BHI HAJAT RAWA-E-ALAM HO
HAIDERIYYAT KA AZM-E-MAUQAM HO
TUM DUA-E-JANAB-E-ZAHRA SE
PURSADAR-E-JANAB-E-ADAM HO
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
You too fulfil the needs of the
world and hold the lofty station of
Haider’s legacy. Through Lady Zahra’s prayer, you
are a mourner from the time of
Adam. You are the seventh remover of
difficulties, the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
BAS JUNOON-O-JABAL JILAWATNI
TERE PYAARO(N) KE TUJHSE HAI PAAYI
KITNE DANA THE TERE DIWANE
UMR BHAR TERI NOKRI KARLI
english translation text:
Your lovers received from you the passion
to bear imprisonment, hardship and exile. How
many wise souls became devoted to you
and spent their lives in your service.
You are the seventh remover of difficulties,\nthe light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TERA BETA IMAM-E-ZAMIN HAI
JISKE QABZE MEI RAAT HAI DIN HAI
WO KHURASAAN KA HAI SHEHZADA
HAR SHIFA USKE DAR PE MUMKIN HAI
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Your son is Imam Zamin, in whose
authority are night and day. He is
the prince of Khurasan, and every cure
is possible at his door. You
are the seventh remover of difficulties,
the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TERI DUKHTAR HAI QUM KI SHEHZAADI
USKI CHOWKAT PE DE SADA JO BHI
JOLIYAA(N) APNI BHAR KE LAATA HAI
GHAMSE MILTI HAI USKO AAZAADI
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Your daughter is the princess of
Qum. Whoever calls at her threshold
returns with full hands and freedom
from grief. You are the
seventh remover of difficulties, the
light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TERE TABOOT KI WO TANHAAYI
NA THA BETA GHAREEB NA BHAAYI
CHAND MAZBOOR AYE UJRAT PAR
LASH RASTE SE TERI UTHWAAYI
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
How lonely was your funeral bier: no
son, no close relative, no brother. A
few labourers, compelled by wages, lifted
your body from the road. You
are the seventh remover of difficulties,
the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
HAI NAJAF DUSHMANO(N) KE NARGHE MEI
KARBALA SAMARA KE RASTE MEI
BEKAFAN MOMINO(N) KE LAASHE HAI
KUFR DAKHIL HUWA MADINE MEI
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Najaf is surrounded by enemies; the roads
to Karbala and Samarra are blocked. The
bodies of believers lie without shrouds,
and disbelief has entered Madina. You
are the seventh remover of difficulties,
the light of the noble Lady.
Maula, you too are the gateway through which needs are fulfilled.

arabic text:
TERA SIKKA JAHAA(N) WAA’IJ HAI
HAM TO HAR IMTIHAA(N) SE GUZRENGE
DENE WALA TUHI NATA’IJ HAI
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Your authority is recognised throughout the world.
We will pass through every trial, for
you are the one who grants the
outcome. You are the seventh remover of
difficulties, the light of the noble Lady.

arabic text:
TU BHI "REHAN" ISTIGHASA KAR
KEHKE YA MUSA YA BIN-E-JAFAR
NAUHA GOYI KARU QAYAMAT TAK
AUR GHULAAMI KARU DAR-E-SHAH PAR
TU SAATHWA MUSHKIL KHUSHA, NOOR-E-JANAAB-E-
SAYYEDA
english translation text:
Rehan, seek help from him too, calling,
‘O Musa, son of Ja‘far.’ May I
compose laments until the Day of Judgement
and remain a servant at the King’s
door. You are the seventh remover of
difficulties, the light of the noble Lady.
O son of Ja‘far, father of Raza—father of Raza.
